name: Ajar
description:
Quick Settings toggle for passwordless sudo, with an amber door in the top bar while it is on.

Requires the Ajar package, installed separately from https://github.com/techbysakh963/ajar (a .deb for Ubuntu, Debian and Kali). This extension contains no scripts or binaries. It only runs the root-owned ajar command (/usr/bin/ajar or /usr/local/bin/ajar). To turn passwordless sudo on, that command asks polkit for your password (pkexec) and runs a fixed, root-owned helper in /usr/libexec/ajar. Turning it off needs no password from your own session. Without the package, the tile shows "Not installed".
